name: Tax returns
summary: Personal and business returns, prepared early and explained in plain English.
description: Federal and state returns for individuals, sole proprietors, S-corps, partnerships and C-corps. We prepare them in February and March, not the night before, and walk you through every number before anything is filed.
includes: Form 1040 and schedules, 1120-S, 1065, 1120, state returns, quarterly estimates, extensions

name: Bookkeeping
summary: Monthly books, reconciled by the fifth, in QuickBooks or Xero.
description: We categorise every transaction, reconcile every account and close the month on time — so your numbers are ready whenever the bank, a buyer or the IRS asks for them.
includes: Bank and card reconciliation, receipts capture, accounts payable, month-end close, one-page monthly report

name: Payroll
summary: Your team paid on time, with every filing that goes with it.
description: Direct deposit, withholding, year-end W-2s and 1099s, and the quarterly payroll returns most owners forget exist. One to fifty employees, one flat monthly fee.
includes: Pay runs, direct deposit, Forms 941 and 940, state unemployment, W-2s, 1099-NECs, new-hire reporting

name: Advisory
summary: A quarterly sit-down on cash, pricing and what to do before year-end.
description: The conversation most small businesses never get: where the money went, what the next two quarters look like, and which moves — entity, salary, retirement, equipment — will actually lower the bill.
includes: Quarterly review, cash-flow forecast, tax planning, entity and salary advice, budgeting

name: IRS & state notices
summary: A letter from the IRS, answered by someone who reads them every week.
description: Send us the letter and stop worrying about it. We work out what it means, reply on your behalf, and set up payment plans or penalty relief where they apply.
includes: Notice review, correspondence, power of attorney, payment plans, penalty abatement, audit support
